verses.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينْ. اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينْ. جَعَلَنَا اللّٰهُ وَإِيَّاكُمْ مِمَّنْ يَسْتَوْجِبُ شَفَاعَتَهْ، وَيَرْجُو مِنَ اللّٰهِ رَحْمَتَهُ وَرَأْفَتَهْ
verses.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi-l-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn. Jaʿalana-Llāhu wa iyyākum mimman yastawjibu shafāʿatah, wa yarjū mina-Llāhi raḥmatahu wa ra'fatah
verses.en: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, bless him and grant him peace, and his family and all his companions. May Allah make us and you among those who merit his intercession and who hope for Allah's mercy and tenderness.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ بِحُرْمَةِ هٰذَا النَّبِيِّ الْكَرِيمْ، وَآلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ التَّابِعِينَ عَلٰى مَنْهَجِهِ الْقَوِيمْ، اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ خِيَارِ أُمَّتِهْ، وَاسْتُرْنَا بِذَيْلِ حُرْمَتِهْ، وَاحْشُرْنَا غَدًا فِي زُمْرَتِهْ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْ أَلْسِنَتَنَا فِي مَدْحِهِ وَنُصْرَتِهْ، وَأَحْيِنَا مُتَمَسِّكِينَ بِسُنَّتِهْ وَطَاعَتِهْ، وَأَمِتْنَا اللّٰهُمَّ عَلٰى حُبِّهِ وَجَمَاعَتِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma bi-ḥurmati hādhā-n-nabiyyi-l-karīm, wa ālihi wa aṣḥābihi-t-tābiʿīna ʿalā manhajihi-l-qawīm, ijʿalnā min khiyāri ummatih, wa-sturnā bi-dhayli ḥurmatih, wa-ḥshurnā ghadan fī zumratih, wa-staʿmil alsinatanā fī madḥihi wa nuṣratih, wa aḥyinā mutamassikīna bi-sunnatih wa ṭāʿatih, wa amitnā-Llāhumma ʿalā ḥubbihi wa jamāʿatih
verses.en: O Allah, by the sanctity of this noble Prophet and of his family and companions who kept to his upright way: place us among the best of his community, shelter us under the hem of his sanctity, gather us tomorrow in his company, employ our tongues in praising and defending him, keep us alive holding fast to his Sunnah and obedience, and let us die, O Allah, upon love of him and of his community.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ادْخِلْنَا مَعَهُ الْجَنَّةَ فَإِنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَدْخُلُهَا، وَأَنْزِلْنَا مَعَهُ فِي قُصُورِهَا فَإِنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَنْزِلُهَا، وَارْحَمْنَا يَوْمَ يَشْفَعُ لِلْخَلَائِقِ فَتَرْحَمُهَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma adkhilnā maʿahu-l-jannata fa-innahu awwalu man yadkhuluhā, wa anzilnā maʿahu fī quṣūrihā fa-innahu awwalu man yanziluhā, wa-rḥamnā yawma yashfaʿu li-l-khalā'iqi fa-tarḥamuhā
verses.en: O Allah, bring us into the Garden with him, for he is the first to enter it; settle us with him in its palaces, for he is the first to dwell in them; and have mercy on us on the day he intercedes for creation and You show it mercy.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا زِيَارَتَهُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةْ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ عَنْكَ وَلَا عَنْهُ قَدْرَ سَنَةْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma-rzuqnā ziyāratahu fī kulli sanah, wa lā tajʿalnā mina-l-ghāfilīna ʿanka wa lā ʿanhu qadra sanah
verses.en: O Allah, grant us his visit every year, and do not let us be heedless of You or of him for even the span of a year.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ فِي مَجْلِسِنَا هٰذَا أَحَدًا إِلَّا غَسَلْتَ بِمَاءِ التَّوْبَةِ ذُنُوبَهْ، وَسَتَرْتَ بِرِدَاءِ الْمَغْفِرَةِ عُيُوبَهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma lā tajʿal fī majlisinā hādhā aḥadan illā ghasalta bi-mā'i-t-tawbati dhunūbah, wa satarta bi-ridā'i-l-maghfirati ʿuyūbah
verses.en: O Allah, leave no one in this gathering of ours except that You wash their sins with the water of repentance and cover their faults with the cloak of forgiveness.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَنَا فِي السَّنَةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ إِخْوَانٌ مَنَعَهُمُ الْقَضَاءُ عَنِ الْوُصُولِ إِلَى مِثْلِهَا، فَلَا تَحْرِمْهُمْ ثَوَابَ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَفَضْلَهَا ۞ رَحِمَهُمُ اللّٰه
verses.tr: Allāhumma innahu kāna maʿanā fī-s-sanati-l-māḍiyati ikhwānun manaʿahumu-l-qaḍā'u ʿani-l-wuṣūli ilā mithlihā, fa-lā taḥrimhum thawāba hādhihi-l-laylati wa faḍlahā · raḥimahumu-Llāh
verses.en: O Allah, brothers and sisters were with us last year whom Your decree kept from reaching another like it — do not deprive them of the reward and merit of this night. May Allah have mercy on them.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْنَا إِذَا صِرْنَا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورْ، وَوَفِّقْنَا لِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ يَبْقَى سَنَاهُ عَلٰى مَمَرِّ الدُّهُورْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma-rḥamnā idhā ṣirnā min aṣḥābi-l-qubūr, wa waffiqnā li-ʿamalin ṣāliḥin yabqā sanāhu ʿalā mamarri-d-duhūr
verses.en: O Allah, have mercy on us when we become people of the graves, and grant us righteous deeds whose radiance endures through the passing of ages.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا لِآلَائِكَ ذَاكِرِينْ، وَلِنَعْمَائِكَ شَاكِرِينْ، وَلِيَوْمِ لِقَائِكَ مِنَ الذَّاكِرِينْ، أَحْيِنَا بِطَاعَتِكَ مَشْغُولِينْ، وَإِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنَا فَتَوَفَّنَا غَيْرَ مَفْتُونِينَ وَلَا مَخْذُولِينْ، وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا مِنْكَ بِخَيْرٍ أَجْمَعِينْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنَا شَرَّ الظَّالِمِينْ (٣x)
verses.tr: Allāhumma-jʿalnā li-ālā'ika dhākirīn, wa li-naʿmā'ika shākirīn, wa li-yawmi liqā'ika mina-dh-dhākirīn, aḥyinā bi-ṭāʿatika mashghūlīn, wa idhā tawaffaytanā fa-tawaffanā ghayra maftūnīna wa lā makhdhūlīn, wa-khtim lanā minka bi-khayrin ajmaʿīn · Allāhumma-kfinā sharra-ẓ-ẓālimīn (3x)
verses.en: O Allah, make us mindful of Your bounties, thankful for Your blessings, and remembering the Day we meet You. Keep us alive occupied in Your obedience, and when You take us, take us untried by temptation and unforsaken, and seal all our affairs with good from You. O Allah, protect us from the evil of the oppressors (3x).

verses.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ فِتْنَةِ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا سَالِمِينْ
verses.en: And keep us safe from the trials of this world.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ هٰذَا النَّبِيَّ الْكَرِيمَ لَنَا شَفِيعًا، وَارْزُقْنَا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَقَامًا رَفِيعًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma-jʿal hādhā-n-nabiyya-l-karīma lanā shafīʿā, wa-rzuqnā bihi yawma-l-qiyāmati maqāman rafīʿā
verses.en: O Allah, make this noble Prophet our intercessor, and through him grant us an exalted station on the Day of Rising.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَرْبَةً هَنِيئَةً مَرِيئَةً لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا، وَاحْشُرْنَا تَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ غَدًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma-sqinā min ḥawḍi nabiyyika Muḥammadin ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama sharbatan hanī'atan marī'atan lā naẓma'u baʿdahā abadā, wa-ḥshurnā taḥta liwā'ihi ghadā
verses.en: O Allah, give us to drink from the Pool of Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ a wholesome, satisfying drink after which we never thirst again, and gather us beneath his banner tomorrow.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا بِهِ وَلِآبَائِنَا وَلِأُمَّهَاتِنَا، وَلِمَشَايِخِنَا وَذَوِي الْحُقُوقِ عَلَيْنَا، وَلِمَنْ أَجْرَى هٰذَا الْخَيْرَ فِي هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةْ، وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتْ، وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتْ، الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma-ghfir lanā bihi wa li-ābā'inā wa li-ummahātinā, wa li-mashāyikhinā wa dhawī-l-ḥuqūqi ʿalaynā, wa liman ajrā hādhā-l-khayra fī hādhihi-l-laylah, wa li-jamīʿi-l-mu'minīna wa-l-mu'mināt, wa-l-muslimīna wa-l-muslimāt, al-aḥyā'i minhum wa-l-amwāt
verses.en: O Allah, through him forgive us, our fathers and our mothers, our shaykhs and all who hold rights over us, whoever brought about this goodness tonight, and all believing and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the departed.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبُ الدَّعَوَاتْ ۞ وَقَاضِيَ الْحَاجَاتْ (٣x) ۞ وَغَافِرَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطِيئَاتْ ۞ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينْ (٣x)
verses.tr: Innaka qarībun mujību-d-daʿawāt · wa qāḍiya-l-ḥājāt (3x) · wa ghāfira-dh-dhunūbi wa-l-khaṭī'āt · yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīn (3x)
verses.en: Truly You are Near, the Answerer of supplications, the Fulfiller of needs (3x), the Forgiver of sins and faults — O Most Merciful of the merciful (3x).

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمْ. سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلٰى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ الْفَاتِحَةْ
verses.tr: Wa ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallam. Subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi-l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn, wa salāmun ʿalā-l-mursalīn, wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi-l-ʿālamīn · al-Fātiḥah
verses.en: And may Allah bless our master Muhammad and his family and companions, and grant them peace. Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe; peace be upon the messengers; and all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Al-Fatiha.
